overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn and Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force Chair Milva McDonald discussed the recent completion of Carr Park and the implementation of a new volunteer communication program. The Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force was created to bridge information gaps between City Hall and residents across Medford's diverse neighborhoods.

items.title: Carr Park Completion and Ribbon Cutting
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn announced the official opening of the Carr Park splash pad and credited federal funding for the installation of basketball courts and solar-powered lighting.

items.title: Origins of the Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force
items.summary: The Mayor explained that the task force was developed to enhance city communications and outreach following feedback from residents and community leaders.

items.title: Task Force Selection Process
items.summary: The administration selected approximately 13 to 15 volunteers from a pool of applicants to ensure two representatives from each neighborhood and a politically diverse membership.

items.title: Communication Goals and Engagement Strategy
items.summary: Ambassadors aim to serve as conduits between residents and city departments, facilitating survey participation and promoting local resources like the Office of Prevention and Outreach.

items.title: Upcoming Outreach and Public Events
items.summary: The task force will host a table at the September 10 farmers market and plans to hold a fall open house at the library to introduce ambassadors to the public.

items.title: Departmental Collaborations
items.summary: The group is partnering with the Medford Public Library on a card registration drive and with the health department to coordinate neighborhood-level responses to rodent issues.

items.title: Administrative Structure and Program Longevity
items.summary: The Mayor clarified that the task force is a volunteer body without legislative mandates or stipends, designed to remain active through at least the next 18 months of her term.

subject: Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force
